description: Metadata for all features used in the EcoPackAI ML models, including engineered indices. Ranges reflect post-MinMaxScaler transformation.

Recyclability (%).meaning: Recyclability potential of the material (scaled from original %).

CO2_Impact_Index.meaning: Composite score measuring overall environmental burden. **Lower value is better/greener.**

Cost_Efficiency_Index.meaning: Composite score measuring cost-effectiveness relative to performance. **Lower value is better.**

Material_Suitability_Score.meaning: Composite score for overall material quality and performance (adjusted for weight penalty). **Higher value is better.**

Material Type_*.meaning: One-Hot Encoded features for different material categories (e.g., Cardboard, Plastic, etc.).

Supplier Region_*.meaning: One-Hot Encoded features for supplier geographical region.
